note: The negative and regression vector set SPEC §13.1 requires of a runtime registration, written before the runtime exists. NOTHING here registers or admits ski@v2. Each case carries `executable_today`: true means the case asserts CURRENT behaviour (the tag is rejected, or a ski@v1 property must not move) and is executed by tests/ski_v2_draft_status.py; false means the case needs a ski@v2 implementation and is not run anywhere yet. A case that is not executed is not evidence, and this field is how the two are kept apart.

m5_fixture.note: One term at two budgets. As ski@v1 reasons both re-runs verdict `pass` and the two §7 fingerprints are EQUAL. That equality is current behaviour, R-20 pins it as complete tuples, and it MUST SURVIVE the admission of ski@v2 unchanged: v2 does not alter what a v1 reason fingerprints to. What differs is the draft ski@v2 tuple for the same pair, which is what the tag is for.
